text_block_list.text:
The crowd congratulates Эйсин Флэш
with a
standing ovation. She smiles
proudly at the
thought that it's her turn
to become an obstacle
for the coming
generation.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The pages of her future schedule are
completely
blank. What path will she
take? How will she
forge onward?
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Fortsetzung folgt—that is to be
determined, and
the rest is up to us.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
